name: Valdetórtola (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valdetórtola (doves on white above a tree on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Valdetórtola; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Valdetórtola arms — doves above a tree
